gen-zen-dots-gf-biorhyme: BioRhyme has brush-lifted curve endings and widely spaced capitals, so it reads bookish and refined. And Zen Dots above it, roomy and techy, gives that serif a friendly, futuristic headline to lean on.
gen-zen-dots-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Zen Dots is a friendly, techy display face with generous space around every letter and openings that never pinch. BioRhyme Expanded, a classic serif, is the one built for settling into text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-biz-udmincho: Zen Dots brings a friendly, techy display look with generous room around each letter, set over BIZ UDMincho, a classic serif with shallow curled terminals. The old-fashioned bookish body against the futuristic heading is the draw.
gen-zen-dots-gf-copse: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots takes the top spot with plenty of space around each letter. Copse, a text serif with daylight showing through every curve, gives it a literary, classic partner, and that gap in character is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-zen-dots-gf-cutive: Cutive spreads its letters wide in running text, with a generous opening in the c, giving it a refined, literary tone. And Zen Dots above it adds a friendly techy headline, so the classic serif underneath feels like a quiet reply.
gen-zen-dots-gf-david-libre: Dignified and refined, David Libre is a classic serif whose terminals hang open instead of closing up. And Zen Dots, friendly and techy above it, leaves the text feeling unhurried and easy to move through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-zen-dots-gf-enriqueta: Techy up top, chalky below. Zen Dots is at its best making a friendly display statement, while Enriqueta, a classic serif with curves that stop short of closing, is the one meant for literary, dignified text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-fenix: Fenix is a classic serif with an editorial feel, its curved strokes ending before they turn inward, set beneath a friendly Zen Dots. The strongest quality here is how a futuristic heading meets old-style text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-gentium-plus: Zen Dots opens things with a friendly, techy display look and generous room around every letter. Gentium Plus, a text serif with the wide mouth of a pitcher in each c, reads in a classic, refined way over many lines.
gen-zen-dots-gf-gowun-batang: Generous space around every letter is what defines Zen Dots, giving it a friendly, techy display presence. But Gowun Batang is the serif made for refined, literary text, with terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
